name: How can I prevent future hot water heater issues?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future hot water heater issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular maintenance is key to preventing future hot water heater problems. This includes flushing the tank annually to remove sediment buildup, which improves efficiency and extends the unit's lifespan. Inspecting the anode rod every few years and replacing it when necessary helps protect the tank from corrosion. Checking for leaks and testing the pressure relief valve also contribute to preventing major issues. Routine professional inspections can catch small problems before they escalate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent issues by regularly flushing the tank, inspecting the anode rod, checking for leaks, and performing routine professional maintenance.
